title.narrative: Finland-UN-Habitat Strategic Partnership for the SDGs

description.narrative:
The strategic partnership is anchored on an incremental approach aimed at capitalizing on rapid gains in 2022, with the objective of expanding cooperation in 2023 and beyond. The key components of the partnership are the following:
Technical Cooperation • Twinning Project. Building on UN-Habitat’s network in Africa, establishing a twinning project between one Finnish and one African city. The project has the aim to support an African city to kick-start and develop its own VLR based on the Finnish methodology, in view of accelerating the SDG localization process.
Knowledge Development • Multilevel Governance. As of 2022, UN-Habitat will start working on a global study on multilevel governance for SDG localization. The aim is to build on the research done already in the Vol.2 of the Guidelines for VLRs and expand research on the connection between VLRs and VNR in Finland. The study will be transformed into an online knowledge platform.
Global Advocacy and Capacity Building • UN-led and international events. Facilitating the participation of Finnish relevant stakeholders in international and UN-led processes linked to the SDGs and organizing dedicated leaning sessions for African partners based on the Finnish experiences.
